newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to higher, gasoline lags.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to higher, gasoline lags.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to higher on Tuesday ahead of a report on European oil inventories.
Naphtha rose on the bounce in crude oil and tighter supply of heavier material. The recent drop in gasoline prices, however, was making the heavy naphtha more expensive.
Gasoline was unchanged despite crude's rally. A closed arbitrage to the U.S. and ample supplies limited gains.
Gas oil prices were slightly firmer with support for benchmark gas oil futures holding and sellers premiums marked up slightly to reflect the $1.50 June/July screen contango.
High sulphur fuel oil barges rose $1 over Monday's levels on tight supplies and perceptions of rising demand, trading at $87 a tonne fob Rotterdam after earlier deals at $1 and $1.50 lower.
The high sulphur cargo market was quiet with buyers sidelined by Monday's high trade at $81.75 a tonne fob Coryton.
